title: Complete privileged CLI live matrix
summary: Local daemon and CLI coverage has expanded, but the remaining privileged verbs need an explicit live coverage matrix so future changes cannot claim complete coverage prematurely.
expectedFailureModes: Status claims complete privileged CLI live coverage without a verb-level matrix.
New privileged commands land without live coverage metadata.
Coverage validation cannot distinguish intentionally deferred verbs from missing tests.
nextAction: Add live coverage only for deferred Solana transaction-preparation verbs after daemon-side signing and settlement deployment readiness exist; keep new privileged CLI verbs out of covered status until a live test lands.
